action.command: cd /workspace && su ddevuser -c "ddev drush uli" 2>&1 | grep -o 'http[^ ]*login' | head -1 > /tmp/uli.txt; cat /tmp/uli.txt; echo "--- test login ---"; ULI=$(cat /tmp/uli.txt); curl -s -L -c /tmp/cookies.txt -o /tmp/loginpage.html -w "%{http_code} %{url_effective}\n" "$ULI"; grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/loginpage.html | head -1; echo "--- access admin ---"; curl -s -b /tmp/cookies.txt -o /dev/null -w "admin: %{http_code}\n" http://openculturas.ddev.site/en/admin
